tasks.title: Configure Windows code-signing inputs for tagged releases
evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml requires npm run release:signing-check before tagged release publication
docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md lists Windows code-signing credentials as an external completion dependency
impact: Tagged Windows releases cannot be treated as release-ready without verified signing inputs.
recommended_action: Provide WIN_CSC_LINK or CSC_LINK and WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD or CSC_KEY_PASSWORD in the tagged-release environment, then rerun the signing gate.
blocked_by: Windows signing certificate material and password are not available in the local environment

inspected_only: ISPEZIONATO: release workflow, signing script, and PROJECT_SPEC release requirements
non_verifiable: NON VERIFICABILE: end-to-end signing validation without release secrets

acceptance_criteria: Tagged release environment provides WIN_CSC_LINK or CSC_LINK
Tagged release environment provides WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD or CSC_KEY_PASSWORD
ONLYSPEECH_REQUIRE_WINDOWS_SIGNING=true npm run release:signing-check passes in the release environment

tasks.title: Validate installer upgrade and rollback against retained comparison installers
evidence: tests/packaged-install-lifecycle.test.ts covers the upgrade and rollback dry-run plan
docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md lists previous signed installers for upgrade and rollback validation as an external completion dependency
impact: Installer lifecycle is not release-verified across upgrade and rollback paths from retained customer versions.
recommended_action: Run the packaged lifecycle script with retained previous and rollback installers before treating the packaged release path as complete.
blocked_by: Previous signed installer and rollback installer are not present in the repository context

inspected_only: ISPEZIONATO: packaged lifecycle script, related test coverage, and release documentation
non_verifiable: NON VERIFICABILE: upgrade and rollback execution without retained installers

acceptance_criteria: A retained previous installer path is supplied to test-packaged-install-lifecycle.ps1
A retained rollback installer path is supplied when rollback validation differs from the previous installer
Packaged lifecycle validation completes install, upgrade, rollback, launch, and uninstall checks without unresolved diagnostics

tasks.title: Complete packaged activation validation on the target workstation
evidence: docs/internal/testing/packaged-activation-commissioning-runbook.md defines the retained activation validation procedure
src/main/trial-tombstone.ts and activation tests cover the local activation and trial mechanisms
impact: Packaged activation, reinstall, trial-expiry, and workstation-specific activation evidence remain incomplete.
recommended_action: Execute the packaged activation runbook on the real target workstation and retain the generated activation evidence artifact.
blocked_by: Real packaged build, target workstation, purchased customer email, and activation code are required

inspected_only: ISPEZIONATO: packaged activation runbook, npm surface, and activation/trial code paths
non_verifiable: NON VERIFICABILE: packaged activation flow without real workstation and customer activation inputs

acceptance_criteria: npm run activation:template refreshes artifacts/logs/activation-validation.json
Valid first activation is recorded as passed with retained evidence
Invalid code and email mismatch checks are recorded with observed outcomes
Startup blocking before activation and startup unlock after persisted activation are recorded
Plan recognition, temporary-plan expiry, and lifetime-plan behavior are recorded or explicitly marked not_applicable with notes
Reinstall with preserved profile and reinstall with removed profile are recorded
Clock rollback behavior is recorded or explicitly marked not_applicable with notes
Copy-risk observation is recorded only when explicitly authorized, or explicitly marked not_applicable with notes

tasks.title: Close target-station commissioning evidence
evidence: package.json exposes npm run commission:template, npm run commission:automation, and npm run commission:handover
scripts/internal/commissioning/write-commissioning-artifact.ps1 defines the target-station validation checks and remaining-check summary
impact: Commissioning evidence for the real workstation remains incomplete, so deployment handover cannot be closed from repository evidence alone.
recommended_action: Run the commissioning template, automation, and handover flow on the target Windows workstation and close all remaining checks.
blocked_by: Real target Windows workstation with its actual displays, microphones, and touch hardware is required

inspected_only: ISPEZIONATO: target-station runbook, npm commands, and commissioning artifact generator
non_verifiable: NON VERIFICABILE: target-station close-out without the real workstation hardware

acceptance_criteria: npm run commission:template refreshes artifacts/logs/target-station-validation.json
npm run commission:automation updates checks it can observe on the active workstation
Manual display-side, microphone-side, provider-exchange, runtime-log, and touch-input checks are recorded as passed, failed, or not_applicable
npm run commission:handover writes artifacts/logs/commissioning-evidence.json
commissioning-evidence.json reports pending target-station checks as 0

tasks.title: Complete live provider speech proof on real hardware
evidence: docs/internal/testing/language-speech-matrix.md defines the manual Microphone -> STT -> translation -> TTS validation matrix
docs/PROJECT_SPEC.md keeps Azure and ChatGPT playback provider-owned with no local TTS fallback
impact: The live speech provider path is not yet closed with retained evidence on real hardware and real credentials.
recommended_action: Run the live provider speech matrix on the target workstation with provisioned credentials and attach the retained proof artifact.
blocked_by: Configured provider credentials, microphones, speakers, and target workstation access are required

inspected_only: ISPEZIONATO: live speech matrix runbook, npm template command, and provider-owned playback boundary
non_verifiable: NON VERIFICABILE: live provider speech validation without real hardware and provider credentials

acceptance_criteria: npm run speech:matrix-template refreshes artifacts/logs/live-provider-speech-proof.json
Initial save behavior is recorded for supported-language and uncovered-language selections
Provider translation validation is recorded for the selected provider
Live microphone or final-turn speech validation is recorded for the selected provider
Translation playback is recorded for the selected provider
Unsupported playback and TTS-disabled runtime behavior are recorded or explicitly marked not_applicable with notes
